concept: Clean clinical-yet-warm palette pairing a confident deep navy with a fresh teal accent over crisp cool-gray and white backgrounds for a precise, trustworthy, modern eye-care brand.
contrastNotes: All pairings meet WCAG-AA. ink #0F1E2E on bg #F6F9FC = 15.96:1 (>=7 required). ink-soft #475569 on bg = 7.17:1 (>=4.5 required). White #FFFFFF on primary #14457E = 9.62:1 (>=4.5 required for CTA labels). primary #14457E on bg = 9.11:1 (>=3 required). Supporting: white on primary-dark #0E3460 = 12.51:1; white on secondary #2B6CB0 = 5.42:1; ink on surface #FFFFFF = 16.86:1 and on surface-alt #EDF2F7 = 14.97:1; ink-soft on surface-alt = 6.73:1. Teal accent #0E8F9C is used for decorative fills/icons/borders rather than as a background for small white text.
